name: Suzuya Hiroki
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c42320]Minako's[/url] older twin brother. He just started at a new school and looks forward to making friends and hopes for a girlfriend but nothing about him stands out. Simply average he's not smart, athletic, or good looking. The only thing about him that's unique is his love of eroge.

When he starts playing a crappy eroge he suddenly gets 'eroge protagonist powers' the ability to alter his fate by making decisions that popup in his life. Whenever he makes a decision he doesn't know what will happen, his body simply acts on its own. He only hopes he can avoid a 'bad end' or 'game over'
